floats_loaded_has_time.name: floats_loaded_has_time
floats_loaded_has_time.value: "floats"."status" <> 'loaded' OR ("floats"."loaded_at" IS NOT NULL AND "floats"."payment_id" IS NOT NULL)

obligations_status_matches_amount.name: obligations_status_matches_amount
obligations_status_matches_amount.value:
("obligations"."status" = 'waived')
        OR ("obligations"."status" = 'due' AND "obligations"."amount_paid_kobo" = 0)
        OR ("obligations"."status" = 'part_paid' AND "obligations"."amount_paid_kobo" > 0 AND "obligations"."amount_paid_kobo" < "obligations"."amount_due_kobo")
        OR ("obligations"."status" = 'paid' AND "obligations"."amount_paid_kobo" = "obligations"."amount_due_kobo" AND "obligations"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL)

payments_settled_needs_verified.name: payments_settled_needs_verified
payments_settled_needs_verified.value: "payments"."settled_at" IS NULL OR "payments"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL
